statement.zh-TW: 槓桿度越高越好，因為營收成長時營業利益會被放大更多倍。
statement.en: The higher the degree of leverage the better, because operating profit is magnified more when revenue grows.

feedbackTrue.zh-TW: 營收成長時高槓桿確實讓利益跳得更快，這部分沒錯。但倍數只是放大器：好年放大獲利，壞年也放大虧損；它告訴你風險有多大，不是一個成績。
feedbackTrue.en: When revenue grows, high leverage does make profit jump faster, that much is right. But the multiple is only an amplifier: it magnifies profit in good years and losses in bad ones, and it tells you how much risk there is rather than giving a grade.

feedbackFalse.zh-TW: 答對了。放大是雙向的：營收下滑時，營業利益也會以同樣的倍數縮水，所以高槓桿表示高風險，不等於好。
feedbackFalse.en: Correct. Magnification works both ways: when revenue falls, operating profit shrinks by the same multiple, so high leverage signals high risk rather than being good in itself.

explanation.zh-TW: {{term:tm_tspyazrx}}與{{term:tm_gkmknxh4}}都是「敏感度」。固定費用與利息讓好年更好、壞年更壞；讀槓桿度時要同時想像營收下滑的情境。
explanation.en: {{term:tm_tspyazrx}} and {{term:tm_gkmknxh4}} are both measures of sensitivity. Fixed costs and interest make good years better and bad years worse; whenever you read a degree of leverage, imagine the downturn as well.
